LESSON OBJECTIVE FIELD: Explain how the nervous system is structured and how its parts work together to detect stimuli and produce rapid responses. 1 — LESSON OBJECTIVES Paste into: Text (concept)

Lesson objectives

At the end of this lesson, you should be able to:

  • 👉 Define the nervous system as the body's rapid communication network.
  • 👉 Describe the organisation of the central nervous system (CNS) and peripheral nervous system (PNS).
  • 👉 Explain the structure of neurones, including axons, dendrites, and the myelin sheath, and how these relate to their function.
  • 👉 Describe how electrical impulses are transmitted along neurones and across synapses.
  • 👉 Use the pathway receptor → sensory neurone → CNS → motor neurone → effector → response in explanations.
